prompt:
Use case: compositing / logo-brand.
Deliver ONE square presentation image with FOUR different polished APP ICON proposals in an equal 2x2 grid. Each icon tile must itself be perfectly SQUARE with full-bleed flat background and square corners. Number the tiles 16, 17, 18, 19 BELOW the tiles, outside the icon art, on a quiet warm-ivory presentation sheet. No other captions.

Input image 1 is an existing oneBeat brand asset: it contains large coral Chinese text on top and the English wordmark "ONEBEAT" below. Use ONLY THE ENGLISH "ONEBEAT" from the bottom of that image. Preserve the provided original lettering's distinctive very heavy condensed italic uppercase shapes, TEAL face, thick NEAR-BLACK outlines and hard offset extrusion. Do not use the Chinese text anywhere. Do not replace the wordmark with a generic typeface. Spell exactly O N E B E A T, one continuous readable word. Keep every letter visible in all four proposals.

Input image 2 is the ORIGINAL existing Wave character artwork from the app: pink-to-purple bob hair with purple bangs, original right-facing profile, cream/peach skin, large dark eye, yellow overalls with cyan shirt, bent forward arm and fist. Reuse THIS SAME original character in all four icons. Treat it as an existing cutout asset, not loose inspiration: preserve original face, hair geometry, costume, colors, expression, right-facing direction, ink lines and walking arm pose. Do NOT redesign her or invent new expressions/gestures. Use bold close crops of the provided original art so the hair, face and recognizable yellow overalls remain clear. No lamp character, cactus, clouds or other characters.

The user rejected four generic portraits on circular backgrounds as insufficiently designed. These must read as cohesive, purposeful launcher icons combining CHARACTER and WORDMARK into a SINGLE interlocked brand emblem. Wordmark is structurally integrated, not a tiny footer label. Strong visual hierarchy: one clear character silhouette, large highly readable original wordmark, at most one graphic motion gesture. Excellent small-size readability; no details except those already in source art. No full scene, no poster layouts or portrait cards.

16 TOP LEFT — WORDMARK AS A STEP: warm ivory #FFF9EE square. Wave's original profile and walking upper body occupy the upper ~70%; large original teal ONEBEAT lettering becomes the broad bold footing across the lower third, slightly overlapping in front of her waist, giving a single joined silhouette. Original black letter extrusion anchors the icon. One short coral beat dash near the hair's trailing edge. No circular frame, no outlined square inside the icon.

17 TOP RIGHT — DIAGONAL DRIVE: full coral #FF7056 square. A bold warm-ivory diagonal ribbon rises from lower-left to mid-right, carrying the large ORIGINAL teal/black ONEBEAT wordmark, following the same slight rising angle without distorting individual letters. Wave's original head, upper yellow overalls and bent fist sit above/behind this shared ribbon. Her forward direction and the wordmark's italic slant feel like one forward-moving graphic. Strong black hard shadow, restrained otherwise, no stickers or extra symbols.

18 BOTTOM LEFT — NIGHT BEAT: full near-black #171B1F square. Large ORIGINAL teal ONEBEAT at the TOP of the icon, on a narrow irregular ivory backing only where needed to preserve the original black extrusion. Wave's original large pink-purple hair/profile and yellow overalls crop fill the middle and lower canvas; her hair and face are completely clear below the logo. One thick open teal motion arc behind her, not a complete portrait circle. Bold high contrast, dark-mode version with the SAME canonical character, no neon/glow effect, no new costume. This layout must feel materially different from the logo-below variants.

19 BOTTOM RIGHT — ONE UNIFIED COMIC BADGE: full pale lavender #C5B7EB square. The original Wave head and original ONEBEAT lettering interlock as a compact energetic cutout brand badge, with a SINGLE shared warm-ivory outer keyline and hard near-black offset shadow around the entire combined silhouette. Character faces right at the top, the original teal wordmark runs across the lower half at a slight dynamic angle and overlaps only her torso, never her face. No rectangular badge container, no individual outline stickers around separate objects; one distinctive joined silhouette. Generous lavender corners for masking, no tiny decorations.

Global constraints: EXACTLY four icons, all with the SAME supplied character and supplied ENGLISH wordmark style; clean fresh layouts and balanced visual mass. Main emblem occupies about 78–85% of each square with clear corners, no pre-rounded outer corners, no fake phone mockups, no extra slogans/brand names, no Chinese characters, no watermarks. Use the application's coral/cream/lavender/teal/ink palette, confident comic illustration and hard graphic contrast. No photorealism or glossy 3D. The purpose is four viable app-icon identity treatments, not four editorial illustrations.
